subject.title: Gateway silently skips channel initialization on plugin/runtime mismatch or missing module files

question: What startup contract should OpenClaw use when a configured channel plugin fails before it reaches the loaded channel registry?
rationale: The source gap is real, but choosing fail-fast versus warn-and-continue behavior, audit summary shape, and whether to include hot reload or performance caching changes affects startup compatibility and operator expectations.

options.title: Add a narrow startup audit
options.body: Record configured channel attempts and plugin-loader failures in a gateway startup summary without changing restart, hot-reload, or fail-fast policy.

options.title: Make mismatches fail fast
options.body: Treat configured channel plugin/runtime incompatibility as a startup-blocking error, accepting a higher compatibility and upgrade impact for clearer failure semantics.

options.title: Keep diagnostics outside startup
options.body: Rely on plugin status, doctor, and channel status diagnostics only, leaving gateway startup as warn-and-continue over loaded channel plugins.

recommendation.title: Add a narrow startup audit
recommendation.body: Record configured channel attempts and plugin-loader failures in a gateway startup summary without changing restart, hot-reload, or fail-fast policy.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the most recent current-main ownership signal on the gateway startup code path and broad adjacent channel lifecycle history.
